
// V_any_startup
func V_any_startup() *Type_type {
 var t_variable *Type_type = T_any
 var e_variable *Type_any = E_any
 V_any_initialize(
  e_variable)
 V_type_t_startup(
  t_variable,
  "vx/core",
  "any",
  E_string,
  e_variable)
 t_variable.P_propertylist = V_varlist_from_listvar(
  []*Type_var{
   V_var_new_private_from_namen_type(
    "backref",
    T_any),
   V_var_new_private_from_namen_type(
    "refcount",
    T_intn),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
    "type",
    T_type),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
    "const",
    T_const),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
    "msgblock",
    T_msgblock),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
    "delta",
    T_delta),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
    "isrun",
    T_booleann)})
 var output *Type_type = t_variable
 return output
}
